name: Minotaur of Crete
desc: A monstrous hybrid with the head of a bull and the body of a towering man. Asterion, the Minotaur, was imprisoned in the sprawling Labyrinth by King Minos and fed on human tributes from Athens before being slain by Theseus.

movements.custom: Perfect Navigation: The Minotaur can never be disoriented or lost within any maze or enclosed structure.

weakness: Ariadne's Thread: The Minotaur relies heavily on its prey becoming lost and panicked in confined spaces. If tracked or bound using a sacred tether or lured into wide open terrain where its maze advantage is neutralized, its morale breaks, reducing its defense and allowing attackers to bypass its natural armor.

actions.name: Labrys Cleave
actions.desc: The Minotaur swings its massive double-headed battleaxe in a wide, devastating arc. Make a melee attack {ATK} dealing severe slashing damage to up to two adjacent targets.

actions.name: Bull Charge
actions.desc: The beast lowers its massive horns and rushes in a straight line toward a foe. Make an attack {ATK}. On a hit, the target takes heavy piercing damage and must succeed on a {DEF} check or be knocked prone and pushed 15 feet.

actions.name: Bellow of the Labyrinth
actions.desc: The Minotaur lets out a bloodcurdling roar that echoes off surrounding surfaces. All enemies within 30 feet must pass a {DEF} check or become shaken, suffering a penalty to their next attack roll.

actions.name: Gory Retaliation
actions.desc: When hit by a close-range attack, the Minotaur instantly lashes out with a gore attack using its deadly horns. The attacker must make a {DEF} check to dodge the counter-strike or take immediate piercing damage.

actions.name: Relentless Trample
actions.desc: Asterion surges through the battlefield in an unstoppable frenzy, moving up to its full speed. Any creature whose space it passes through must make a {DEF} check or be stomped into the dirt, taking heavy bludgeoning damage.
